content.prompt: Engine and fuel chemistry - match each pollutant story to its cause.

items.text: oxides of nitrogen form in car engines
sulfur dioxide forms when fuels burn
dilute sulfuric and nitric acids form in the atmosphere

targets.text: the temperature is high enough for N2 and O2 from air to react
the hydrocarbon fuel carries sulfur impurities from the crude oil
SO2 and NOx dissolve in rainwater (and oxidise) - acid rain
